column1: # Hand-maintained list of reclaimed areas (existing content that nothing reads) for tools/freespace.py.
# Columns (tab-separated): start, end (exclusive), kind (text | code), status, source, note.
# status: checked = verified by hand in the source study; auto = found by an automatic rule only
#         (the tool gives NEEDS-DECISION for auto rows).
# Seeded from experiments/2026-11-13-reclaim-space/README.md section 4 (rows 1-10). Row 11 is 0xFF and is found by the tool.
# Removed 2026-11-14: 7E50A201-7E50A3C2 and 7E53A55C-7E53A700. They are the sleep routine (pwr_standby start) and its
# helper, called from the code that runs in SRAM (0x470010F7). The function map does not see those callers.
